items.title: Store the full approved design
items.description: One skill (/mission-ctrl:start) runs add-idea, triage, spec-create, and design-propose in one conversation. design-propose writes the whole design to .mission/designs/<spec_id>.md (goal, in scope, out of scope, expected files). design-approve marks it as the active design.

items.title: Design guard on Edit and Write
items.description: A thin mod hooks tool.check on Edit/Write. A small model compares the edit with the active design and returns fits, drift, or unclear. Drift asks the user; fits passes silently. Every verdict is logged.

items.title: Five-day dogfood with an eval set
items.description: Use the guard on this repo and on e2eeval for five working days. Record false asks and missed drift. Turn them into claude plugin eval cases.
